revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the service manager framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The risk review no longer accepts a plan that is only good in the central case. The same front-office choices have to make sense across the cases in the data pack, while the case-specific consequences settle afterward. The fertilizer plan now reports a resilience score rather than raw leftover lots. For each product, the first `priority_reserve_lots` closing lots count fully, while inventory above that band counts at `excess_reserve_credit`. Extended machine schedules still consume the shared skilled-labor pool and carry `extended_mode_penalty` in the score. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
